description: This file implements a Gauge interface using Kamon metrics library, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve gauge metrics with tagging support.

classes.name: KamonGauge
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Gauge interface using Kamon metrics library to manage gauge metrics with tagging support.

methods.name: newGauge
methods.description: Factory method to create a new KamonGauge instance with a specified name and empty tags.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to a specific value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the gauge.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with an additional tag.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with multiple tags added.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the gauge.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the gauge value to zero.

methods.name: getKamonInternalGauge
methods.description: Retrieves the internal Kamon gauge object with the current tags.
